text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the Kikuka-sho, Rice Shower rose to 
instant stardom.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then, one day. Mihono Bourbon, who had 
remained injury-free despite any grueling 
training, ended up getting hurt.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Believing it was her fault Mihono Bourbon 
got injured by making her a rival, Rice 
Shower withdrew deep into her shell.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Facing her directly, Mihono Bourbon made 
it clear beyond doubt that her injury had 
nothing whatsoever to do with Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At a loss for words, Rice Shower found 
herself unable to respond.
